verses.text: Look, a king will rule with righteousness, and leaders will rule with justice.
Each one will be like a shelter from the wind and a hiding place from the storm, like streams of water in a dry land, like the shade of a large rock in a tired, thirsty land.
Then the eyes of those who see will no longer be closed, and the ears of those who hear will listen.
The minds of those who act too quickly will understand and know. Those who stutter will speak clearly and easily.
Fools will no longer be called noble, and cheats will no longer be highly respected.
For fools speak foolishness, and their minds plan evil. They do godless things and spread lies about the LORD. They leave the hungry empty and keep water from the thirsty.
The ways of cheats are evil. They make wicked plans to destroy the poor with lies, even when the needy are in the right.
But noble people make noble plans, and by noble deeds they stand.
Get up, you women who are so comfortable, and listen to me! You daughters who feel so secure, hear what I say!
In a little more than a year, you who feel so secure will tremble. For the grape harvest will fail, and the fruit harvest will not come.
Tremble, you women who are so comfortable! Shake with fear, you who feel so secure! Take off your fine clothes and put sackcloth around your waists.
Beat your breasts in sorrow for the pleasant fields and the fruitful vines,
and for the land of my people, where thorns and briers will grow. Yes, mourn for all the happy homes in this joyful city.
For the palace will be deserted, and the busy city will be empty. The hill and the watchtower will become caves forever, a joy for wild donkeys, a pasture for flocks,
until the Spirit is poured out on us from heaven. Then the wilderness will become a fruitful field, and the fruitful field will seem like a forest.
Justice will live in the wilderness, and righteousness will stay in the fruitful field.
The result of righteousness will be peace. Its effect will be quietness and confidence forever.
My people will live in peaceful homes, in safe houses, in quiet places of rest,
even if hail flattens the forest and the city is completely torn down.
How blessed you will be, sowing your seed by every stream, and letting your oxen and donkeys roam freely.
